creator: griffybit
statement: He used legitimate grinding and practice with no exploits or cheats to get 11 megalodon trophies and teaches fishing minigame tricks

creator: griffybit
statement: Megalodon trophy needs consecutive fish catches: tier one fish unlocks eel then squid then whale then it resets

creator: griffybit
statement: Must catch the whale three times; on the third whale spawn catch other fish until megalodon spawns then catch it and trophy drops

creator: griffybit
statement: Only nine megalodon trophies are needed; he got 11 as a fail-safe for new characters coming out

creator: griffybit
statement: Use the top dock as a graph for where to throw power; no BPM or special trick needed just proper positioning

creator: griffybit
statement: Click the portal then click back before entering so you go past; in the minigame the rope lines up at 1.5 power confirming overlay

creator: griffybit
statement: Tiny dash lines on the dock indicate power values: near rope is 1 then 3 then 4 then 5 then 6 and dock edge is 7

creator: griffybit
statement: Power 7 will not reach across the whole water so remember that

creator: griffybit
statement: Fishing minigame works in quarter increments: quarter then half then three-quarter then full

creator: griffybit
statement: If fish sits between dashes for three and four estimate three and a half and measure power accordingly

creator: griffybit
statement: If you miss the throw it resets back to the start before you summon it so missing is fine

creator: griffybit
statement: Being slightly off is fine as long as the throw is mostly in line with the fish

creator: griffybit
statement: Use the tip of the parasol as an instant indicator for which dock line is which number; then hit at four and a quarter

creator: griffybit
statement: Go for the closest fish not for points since the goal is the megalodon trophy

creator: griffybit
statement: Higher tier fish are easier to catch

creator: griffybit
statement: If a fish lines up with your marker always go for it; only use quarters or halves as last resort

creator: griffybit
statement: Line the bobber up with the dock marker on the fish for a clear indicator such as lining with the three

creator: griffybit
statement: If fish is near three but closer to one and a half add a little pep and hit it with a two

creator: griffybit
statement: Look for the drag; the drag line lines you up every single time

creator: griffybit
statement: He caught all megalodons on stream except maybe one off stream so it's legitimate
